content.text:
I found two places on their own pages. I couldn't confirm either one for September 12 to 15 itself, so the hours below are their regular hours.

- **Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM):** 
It's on the Upper West Side, and its exhibits and programs are for children ages 0-6.
 
Its page lists hours of Tuesday–Sunday, 10 am–5 pm.
 That means it is closed on Monday unless it's a holiday. 
Daily programming includes a 10:30 am Circle Time and a 4:00 pm storytime.
 The page gives no admission price. It does say 
you save $1 when you book online.

- **Central Park Zoo:** 
It opens every day at 10am. From April to October it closes at 5pm Monday through Friday and 5:30pm on weekends and holidays.
 
Admission includes the Main Zoo and the Children's Zoo.
 The zoo's page doesn't give a price or a preschool age range. That FAQ page also looks older, so check the hours before you go.

I left out the New York Hall of Science, which has a Preschool Place for ages 6 and under. I could only find its hours on third-party sites, not its own page.
